title: Richard Cowan Receives NORML Lifetime Achievement Award

content_html_sanitized:
Source: http://www.marijuananews.com

Posted February 4, 2000

Last night, at a ceremony following the first day of the NORML Conference, Dr. Lester Grinspoon presented me with the NORML Foundation’s 2000 Lifetime Achievement Award.

Dr. Grinspoon, of the Havard Medical School, is the author of Marihuana, the Forbidden Medicine and Marihuana Reconsidered.

The plaque reads, " In Grateful Recognition of A Lifetime Dedicated to Reforming Unjust Marijuana Laws and Advancing the Cause of Personal Freedom. "

I am a very grateful for the award and also very glad that it gave me the opportunity to say that I would not have been able to anything while I was National Director without the help and counsel of my friend Allen St. Pierre, who is now the Executive Director of the NORML Foundation. I still rely on Allen for his insights and unique knowledge of the issue.

An award was also given to my friends, Prof. Lynn Zimmer and Dr. John P. Morgan for having written Marijuana Myths; Marijuana Facts, and for their many other contributions to the marijuana reform movement .

Prof. Arnold Trebach, another old friend and the founder of the Drug Policy Foundation, was also presented with the 1999 Life Time Achievement Award, which he was not able to accept last year, due to a brief illness.
